column1: # clues.tsv for ft_rev_int_tab — hints only, never answers.

Reversing in place means the array itself is rearranged, with no second array. After the call, where should the first element be, and the last? Trace your code on {10, 20}: what does the array hold after each step, and does any element move more than once?
Look at the tiny inputs: size 0 and size 1. How many elements should change place there, and does your code touch anything when there is nothing to reverse?
Nothing in the subject says how big the array is. Does anything in your function stop working when it is bigger than the arrays you tried it on?
